verdict.rationale: Glama runs first-party MCP endpoints that agents connect to directly. Deploying a registry server puts Glama's Gateway in front of it, and the endpoint you get is a Glama-hosted, logged, access-controlled MCP URL. However, the evidence shows no official Glama MCP server that exposes Glama's own capabilities, such as directory search, which the OpenAPI evidence says is REST-only. missing for 10: an official first-party MCP server for Glama's own directory/API functionality, setup docs for connecting an agent to it, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Every MCP call from your agents flows through Glama
No proxy setup, no manual wiring – the endpoint you get is the Gateway.
Every call through this URL is logged, access-controlled, and credential-managed
